response.original_title: Room@Guide-How do i add a room to My Icon of the Sea Cruise booking?
response.overview: To add an additional stateroom or room to 1-866-259-1002 an existing Icon of the Sea Cruise reservation, you must book the new room as a separate reservation and call Icon of the Sea Cruises Customer Support at 1-866-259-1002 (or contact your travel agent) to link the booking numbers. To add an entirely separate room to an existing Icon of the Sea Cruise +1-866-259-1002 (USA) or ☎ (UK) reservation, you cannot do it online; you must call Icon of the Sea Cruise directly at ☎ +1-866-259-1002 (USA) or ☎ (UK) or contact your travel agent. To add a second room to an existing Icon of the Sea Cruises 1- 866-259-1002 or reservation, you must call Icon of the Sea Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1-866-259-1002 or, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app.
